assert_is_instance_check_type: assert an object is an instance of a given class and raise TypeError if not
none_throws_guard_none: throw a ValueError when a value is None, optionally with a custom message
test_assert_is_instance: test the assert_is_instance function to verify it raises TypeError for wrong types
test_none_throws: test the none_throws function to verify it raises ValueError when given None
review_typing_utilities: review the typing utility functions assert_is_instance and none_throws for correctness
